config.domain_note: Free-text field. Recommended values: paid-media, content, lifecycle, website, campaigns, operations, cross-surface. Each department's instruction file defines which keywords it matches on — that's the authoritative routing, not this config.

config.archive_policy: Process 3.8 archives acted-on entries weekly during Friday synthesis. Archived entries move to archived_entries array (preserved for audit). Active entries = un-acted + last 90 days acted.

entry_types._note: Descriptive, not an exclusive enum. New types can emerge as the system learns.
entry_types.skill_update: Decision rules, evaluation frameworks, thresholds, confirmed patterns — destined for skill files via Process 3.8
entry_types.process_change: Operational changes to domain/dept instructions, data pulls, pipeline steps. Entries with changeset_candidate: true surface as ChangeSet proposals.
entry_types.threshold_calibration: Threshold tuning (e.g., CPL boundaries) — requires measurement before committing to skill file
entry_types.changeset_outcome: Auto-appended when any ChangeSet closes. Includes outcome_class (confirmed/minor_variance/significant_variance) and variance_pct for estimation calibration.
entry_types.content_pattern: Content performance pattern bridged from Moe's Performance Memory with cross-domain implications. Platform-specific hook weights stay in content-producer-skill.md §3.
